name: Radon Number of Singletons
proof: Every nonempty subfamily $G$ of the singleton class is a version space: prescribe label zero on the coordinates whose singleton targets are outside $G$. Thus $G$ is convex and its convex hull equals $G$. In every nontrivial partition of the full class, the two parts have disjoint convex hulls. All $n$ concepts are therefore Radon independent. No independent subset can have more than the $n$ concepts of the class, proving the value $n$, including $n=1$ when the partition condition is vacuous.
